subject: webhook redelivery question
body: Dev here - we checked our endpoint logs and we're seeing repeated connection timeouts (522) on inbound webhook calls from your platform around 5th Sept afternoon, looks like our server had a brief outage window. Can you confirm whether the retry window has fully lapsed for the refund.processed event tied to our order from that day, and is there a way to trigger a manual redelivery from our side via API or does it have to be from the dashboard?
